title: TopologyRelationshipSourceSelector
description: Catalog-backed selector for relationship source resolution. It reuses semantic selector predicates but omits actionCatalogId because selecting a relationship source is not itself a visual topology action.

semanticEntity.description: Semantic entity being selected as the relationship source, for example inventory.device, inventory.interface, or network.vlan.

surfaceEntity.description: Topology surface entity used to resolve the source selector.

targetKind.description: Topology graph element kind expected after selector evaluation.

predicates.description: Catalog-backed predicates combined with AND semantics. topology-service evaluates the predicates against the active graph and validates the result against the requested relationship.
